description: This bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different stages of the Audio back-end Conformer, comparing various attention mechanisms and a feed-forward component. The x-axis represents the Audio back-end Conformer Stage, with three categories: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125), listed in order from left to right. The y-axis is labeled "Module Giga FLOPs" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each stage is represented by a group of four bars: attention (blue), grouped attention (g=3) (red), patch attention (k=3) (yellow), and feed-forward (green). For Stage 1, the bars have approximate values of 0.275 (attention), 0.15 (grouped attention), 0.12 (patch attention), and 0.13 (feed-forward). For Stage 2, the values are approximately 0.16 (attention), 0.12 (grouped attention), 0.1 (patch attention), and 0.13 (feed-forward). For Stage 3, the values are approximately 0.12 (attention), 0.1 (grouped attention), 0.09 (patch attention), and 0.13 (feed-forward). The bars within each group are not stacked, and the groups are not sorted in a specific order other than the stage order. No bars are visually emphasized.
